signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use the email and temporary password your company owner gave you.

errors.passwordInvalid: Use 8–12 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one symbol.

suspended.body: Contact your company owner to restore access.

unavailable.title: We could not load your account
unavailable.body: Check your connection and try again.

import.title: Import roster from Excel
import.description: Upload the roster file. People are added or updated, then their sign-in accounts are created.
import.chooseHint: Upload a .xlsx file with an Employees sheet. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.passwordNote: Passwords in the file are used once to create sign-in accounts and are never stored. Each person picks their own password at first sign-in.
import.invalidIntro: {{count}} rows need fixing. Nothing was imported.
